purpose: Review F2 of rd-7: `ve document check` cost on n two-reading sets (no couplings), measured on the fixed code; the Lean service is a child process, so its CPU is included.
command: /usr/bin/time -f '%U %S %e' uv run python -I f2.py N  (f2.py: the review's F2 probe, printing the prove_entailment count)
